parameters.query:
WITH phase_map(phase, ord, label) AS (VALUES
  ('intake',          1, 'Intake'),
  ('briefing_done',   2, 'Briefing OK'),
  ('design_done',     3, 'Diseno OK'),
  ('analysis_done',   4, 'Analisis OK'),
  ('costs_done',      5, 'Costes OK'),
  ('trades_done',     6, 'Gremios OK'),
  ('proposal_done',   7, 'Propuesta OK'),
  ('approved',        8, 'Aprobado'),
  ('planning_done',   9, 'Plan OK'),
  ('completed',      10, 'Completado'),
  ('archived',       11, 'Archivado')
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'phase_counts', (SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.ord) FROM (
    SELECT pm.phase, pm.label, pm.ord, count(p.id)::int AS n
    FROM phase_map pm LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.current_phase = pm.phase
    GROUP BY pm.phase, pm.label, pm.ord
  ) t),
  'totals', (SELECT json_build_object(
    'total', count(*),
    'active', count(*) FILTER (WHERE current_phase NOT IN ('completed', 'archived')),
    'completed', count(*) FILTER (WHERE current_phase = 'completed'),
    'archived', count(*) FILTER (WHERE current_phase = 'archived')
  ) FROM projects),
  'avg_days_completed', (
    SELECT round(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.updated_at - p.created_at))/86400)::numeric, 1)
    FROM projects p WHERE p.current_phase IN ('completed', 'archived') AND p.updated_at > p.created_at
  ),
  'stale_projects', (
    SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.days_stale DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT p.id::text AS project_id, p.name, p.current_phase, c.name AS client_name,
        floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - coalesce(p.updated_at, p.created_at)))/86400)::int AS days_stale
      FROM projects p JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id
      WHERE p.current_phase NOT IN ('completed', 'archived')
        AND coalesce(p.updated_at, p.created_at) < now() - INTERVAL '14 days'
      ORDER BY days_stale DESC LIMIT 12
    ) t
  ),
  'recent_completed', (
    SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.completed_at DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT p.id::text AS project_id, p.name, c.name AS client_name,
        p.updated_at AS completed_at,
        floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.updated_at - p.created_at))/86400)::int AS total_days
      FROM projects p JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id
      WHERE p.current_phase IN ('completed', 'archived') AND p.updated_at > p.created_at
      ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC LIMIT 8
    ) t
  ),
  'agent_activity_7d', (
    SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.runs DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT agent_name, count(*)::int AS runs,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed')::int AS failures
      FROM agent_executions
      WHERE started_at > now() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND agent_name IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY agent_name
    ) t
  )
) AS report;
